Dialogs.Dialog: Huh？ ...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? You're the one who got all small...
I'm not small. I'm already a grown-up.
(Come to think of it... I've been in a situation like this before...)
(But the little ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ I met before was a lot more energetic. If I remember right...)
You told me to call you that, remember？ And you said you'd make ● your servant.
...Did I？ I forgot all about stuff from that long ago.
You know, 'All hail Lady Nene!' and all that.
Jeez, stop it. You're acting like a kid...
Like a kid... Aren't you still one...?
I'm a grown-up, you know？ I'll be in middle school soon.
...What is it？ Stop staring at me.
I was just thinking I guess I won't get to see the bossy Lady Nene anymore.
That was... just playing around. I can't stay a kid forever...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has a different vibe from before...)
It's not like I wanted to look more grown-up than the other kids.
Sometimes I do think about how I want to play like we used to, but...
I can't exactly do that anymore...
So, you see, I've graduated from all that.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really does seem like an adult...)
● really liked that Lady Nene, too, you know.
Yeah, you were cute, a little cool, and fun. Playing with you was a blast!
You really are a kid. You shouldn't use the word 'like' with a girl to mean that.
I'll teach you what it means someday. When you and I are both a little older...
Until then... you'll wait for me, right？
Yeah, I'll wait... I'll wait for you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
Little ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was so cute... and still so pretty, too...
(I wonder if she'd remember if I said, "All hail Lady Nene!"？)
Say "All hail Lady Nene!" into the microphone.
I shouldn't be selfish and tell you not to go...
To the battlefield, of course. ...Leaving me, your fiancée, behind.
Fiancée!? Wait, ●, when did you put on a military uniform...
Ugh... so suddenly... I'm not emotionally prepared for this yet.
Right... ● is deploying to the front lines now...
Just thinking I won't see you tomorrow makes the tears pour out... *sob*...
We finished the engagement and wedding preparations... We were just waiting for the day...
If you don't come back, I won't be able to live anymore...
A world without you has no meaning to me.
So... please be safe. Please don't forget that there's a woman eagerly awaiting your return.
I'll keep that in mind. ...But I have one request for you, too.
Yes. If it's something I can do, ask as many as you like, not just one.
Just one is fine... Could you smile for me？
I want to see your smile.
At a time like this, I can't...
It'd be lonely if the last thing I saw was your crying face.
Don't say it's the last time.
Ah, I didn't mean it like that... This is tough. I just want to see your smile rather than tears before I go.
...Hehe, you're treating me like a child...
For ●, it's pretty much the same thing.
...Yeah. That face is definitely much better.
I'll be waiting for your return. Forever, and ever... always...
If you come back to me...
If you come back to me... Then... even if you become a zombie!
It's okay, I saw it in a movie yesterday. A doctor who sold his soul to the devil resurrects the dead!
If you're worried, want to try a practice run right now？
First, let's see... we restrain the patient.
Huh... Whoa, I can't move？ Sleep paralysis!?
Then we knock them out with an electric shock... Hmm, we don't have that nowadays, so skip！
Next, we finally get to the body...
Hey, what do you mean skip!? At least take this seriously！
Were you not told？ I am Lady Nene, serving as the senior lady of the Ooku.
I am not a senior！ And you will call me Lady Nene！
I am Takanekoji, serving as an Ochuro. A pleasure.
Wow, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ really does have an elegant vibe.
Lady Takanekoji comes from a noble family.
Please do not stare at me so intently...
Huh, ▲小早川＊▲'s name is exactly the same.
Insolence！ Are you mocking the Kobayakawa clan!?
Lady Kobayakawa comes from a samurai family.
Hey! Do not ring the bell without permission!
Now then. What kind of woman do you think would please the Shogun?
Do not 'huh' me. The Shogun's dislike of women is well known. Not only are there no visits, but we have been ordered to downsize the Inner Chambers.
At this rate, the shogunate itself is in danger. Do you not agree?
Speak clearly. Why do you think we brought you into the strictly women-only Inner Chambers?
Uh, so basically, you want to know the Shogun's type, right?
(The Shogun's type, the Shogun's type... Wait, what kind of person is the Shogun anyway?)
This is troubling... In that case, your own preference will do. Tell me.
●'s type? Are you sure that's okay?
A rare male opinion is better than nothing. Here, what about Lady Takane-no-koji or Lady Kobayakawa, for example?
You are prepared for the consequences, I assume? The crime of mocking me, Lady Nene, is a heavy one.
I'm not mocking you! ● really likes you.
Lady Kobayakawa, I didn't know Lady Nene could make a face like that.
Hehe, maybe this is her true self.
E-Enough of this! You will be the one to care for the Shogun after all!
Indeed. The Shogun belongs to the order Carnivora, family Canidae, genus Nyctereutes... Round, with a fluffy tail, and quite charming.
By the way, according to the laws of the Inner Chambers, you are henceforth forbidden from contacting anyone other than the Shogun. You shall spend your life caring only for the Shogun.
Huh, did the Inner Chambers really have a rule like that?!
See that you serve with all your heart.
Don't worry. I was happy to hear what you said earlier... so I'll make sure to come visit you, too.
Aw geez, cut it out! Come on, let's go! To see the Shogun...
...Wow, I just had a crazy dream...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a gorgeous kimono... Nice...
(I wonder what happens if I ring this bell？)
Hehehe... The day has finally arrived!
The world-famous Twin Peaks. I've waited so long to climb them... Let's go!
Thought I heard something. Just my imagination？ Oh well...
The ground sure is soft... Alright, time to plant my ice axe...
Must be hearing things... Guess I can do without it.
This is as far as I go... Alright, I'll bivouac here for the night.
Let's see... Time to start a fire...
Whoa, my field of vision suddenly opened up...
...These are some amazing Twin Peaks... Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is a giant!?
Jeez, what've you been doing this whole time？ At a time like this!
What do you mean？ Because it's there!
？ No, not that... Jeez, you came to save me, didn't you？
(A captive giant tied down... I see... This is like...)
Uh... Right, right! I came to save you! Mountain climbing, what was I thinking, hahaha!
Thank you... I appreciate it, but you need to run. Before they come back.
I guess they never accepted me. They said I wasn't good enough for you...
● isn't good enough for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Who'd say something so selfish？
Everyone. Everyone in the whole world.
Yeah, the whole world is our enemy now.
The whole world is against ●... Why did it come to this...
I guess it's my fault for being so big.
No way... ● would never break up with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
I can't. I'm tied up so tight that I can't move at all.
If you stay, you'll get caught too. You have to run away on your own.
There's no way I could just leave ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ behind like this!
You're in much more danger than I am right now. They execute traitors, you know.
I don't care! ● would never abandon ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
...Just hearing you say that is enough. You've made me so incredibly happy.
Our time together was short, but you gave me a lifetime of happiness. So I'm not scared.
If you get caught, just tell them you hate me. That way, they'll spare your life.
They've come to capture you. They're too worked up to listen to reason right now... Run.
Huh？ Wait, ● can't just do this alone...
Even if the whole world turns on you, ● will always be on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s side!
What's wrong, are you tired？ We did come straight from the wedding venue, after all.
It's always been my dream to come to this country for my honeymoon. Thanks for making it come true, darling▼
Nothing, it's just suddenly starting to feel real...
Only just now？ You're so cute, honestly.
This is a nice room. The furniture, the lighting, the scent, this bed...
Yeah, it's great. Especially this flower petal welcome service.
It'd be a shame to mess it up, wouldn't it?
(...I'm getting kind of nervous. I should say something...)
You said it was always your dream to come to this country, right...?
It's a classic! Ever since I was little, I knew I'd honeymoon here. I even wrote an essay about it!
And now my dream has come true. All thanks to my wonderful hubby.▼
I see. If you're that happy about it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, then I'm glad we came.
(...Wait, what country is this again? Um...)
Hold on, I need to mentally prepare myself!
What's wrong? The ceremony has already started, you know？
The Pokorin Kingdom honeymoon ceremony, of course! Now, Pon-Poko-Rin!
(I feel like something like this has happened before...)
Here we go! Just 100 more sets!
What, it was just a dream...
...And here I thought it was a good one...
And now for today's forecast. Towano City's weather will worsen by evening, with scattered showers tonight.
(Huh, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Why is she on TV...)
This is no time to zone out! If our ratings drop below 1% today, we're all fired!
Ah, we're at 1.7% now! It's all over!
You can't just spring that on me!
Next up is meteorologist Geromaru-kun's Weather Geta Forecast Corner!
Geromaru-kun will predict the weather by kicking his geta sandals!
(Wait. Didn't ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ hate frogs...? Is she okay with this?)
Today, I'm going to try kicking my shoe with Geromaru-kun. Let's do our best, Geromaru-kun!
I drank too much yesterday. This old man is showing his age...
...Isn't this character the reason our ratings are tanking？
Do your best, Geromaru-kun! Alright, here I go!
...Ah. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, if you lift your leg that high...
The moment Anegasaki-san lifted her leg, they shot right up! We broke 5% for a second!
...I see, so that's a tactic... No, no, I can't use ●'s girlfriend for something like that...
...Right! I've got newfound respect for you, Producer!
I love this show. The show that we built together!
I can keep doing my best!
Yeah! That way it's natural, so it'll be fine!
(Wind, huh... Then I'll just blow some air...)
(To make wind, I have to blow into the mic...)
Yeah, that's it! Just a little more!
Oh no, I blew too hard! At this rate, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s skirt will...!
No matter what happens, take good care of your girl. Otherwise... you'll lose sight of what's most important.
Heh, guess a frog just said something out of character.
Not at all! Thank you, Geromaru-kun!
Yeah, what is it! You make sure to protect what's most important to you, too...
Ratings are at 0%... right after Geromaru-kun's NG.
Localized heavy rain is expected today. Please be ve~ry careful of sudden torrential downpours.
...A dream, huh. ...Wait, why is it... so cold...
(I'll blow hard into the mic to make some wind!)
Over here! Look, what a great view!
Haha. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, it's dangerous if you rush too much~.
The wound is turning purple... It might be venom...
Hang in there! In times like this... uh, tie off the side closer to the heart, then...
Right, that's it! Here I go!
It's fine. I'm okay, so keep going...
(It feels so soft... No, no! This is no time to be thinking about that!)
(If I suck too hard, it'll leave a mark. But I have to get all the venom out...)
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you okay？ I sucked out quite a bit...
Hang in there, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!! Don't fall asleep!
I can't... I'm so sleepy... If I sleep now, will I ever wake up again...？
Stay with me! You're going to make it!
I'm sorry... Our date was supposed to be special...
I said don't worry about it! We can have a date anytime...
What do you mean by that？ I've been looking forward to this date! And you just brush it off like nothing!
No! I can't believe you took our date so lightly... I can't take this...!!
What!? No, that's not what ● meant...
Ooh, I shall not leave this grudge unavenged... *thud*
...I shouldn't make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ mad. I need to be careful about the little things I say.
(I need to suck the poison out of the wound, fast!)
What's wrong, spacing out？ It's dangerous, you know？
What, are you still not used to me calling you that？
(Oh right... ● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ are right in the middle of our newlywed life...)
Honey!? Are you okay？ Let me see.
I'm fine, I'm fine. I just need to cool it with water.
Hey, it's too early for that.
(With such a cute and sweet wife... ● must be the happiest guy in the world!)
Yeah, I think this is about right... Hey？
Could you give this a little taste？
It's hot, so blow on it before tasting it, okay？
It's hot like this, so let it cool down, okay？
(I just need to blow on it to cool it down...)
Hehe. Jeez, you're doing it on purpose, aren't you.
Messing around in the kitchen... it's dangerous, right？
Delicious! ●'s wife is the absolute best!
Really？ Did you actually taste it properly？
I did, I did! But I want to savor it, so one more bite!
Hehe, you can have more when it's done. I just need to plate it, so go sit down.
Okaaay, I'll be a good boy.
Okaaay, I'll be a good boy.
There, there, good boy. It'll be weady weal soon, okay~？
Jeez, you're such a big baby, ▼.
...Nn... Huh, this is ●'s room. Then, was that... a dream？
Goo goo... Is ● acting too spoiled with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
(I just need to touch her earlobe...)
(I need to blow on it to cool it down...)
Sir~, did you fall asleep？ Hehe.
(Is this voice... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Where on earth am I...)
(What the, there's a towel over my face...)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is this... a hair salon？)
(I want a good look at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ while I have the chance.)
I'm almost done shampooing~. Are there any itchy spots？
Umm...... are there any itchy spots？
(If I don't say "I'm fine," she'll keep washing my hair forever...)
I'll go ahead and rinse it now~.
(Having ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wash my hair feels so good... No wonder I fell asleep earlier.)
(Ah, that feels so good... I'm gonna fall asleep again...)
There we go... How is it~？
Umm, it's a great view, I guess...
Huh？ I meant the water temperature.
Oh, right! Yeah, it's totally fine! Perfect!
Hehe. You're a funny one, sir.▼
We're almost done~. If it hurts or the water's too hot, don't hesitate to tell me.
(Ahh... Best salon ever. But thinking about her doing this for other guys makes me feel kinda conflicted...)
You weren't answering me. Hehe, did it feel that good？
You bet! This must be what they call paradise.
Oh stop it~, you're such a flatterer.▼
All right, all done washing. I'll give you a massage next, okay？
Excuse me~, I'd like a massage please~.
First time here, sir？ I'll give you some special service~.
...Huh？ My room... It was a dream.
Ouch... I think I slept on my neck wrong...
Look, look, I got so much♪
(I wonder how long it's been since ● and I washed up on this island...)
(At first we were both just confused, but as expected, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was the first to adapt to island life...)
(She went and gathered all this fruit for us again today. Meanwhile, I...)
Sorry, no luck today either. I couldn't catch a single fish.
I see... It can't be helped. Fish move around, unlike fruit. It takes some getting used to.
Sorry for making you do all the work, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Jeez, don't worry about it. You got the coconuts and leaves for this outfit. You do plenty for me, too.
...The weather is always so nice here.
Yeah, you can see the horizon so clearly.
...It's just the two of us, isn't it？
No. As long as I have you, I wouldn't mind being alone together forever. Just like this, until death do us part...
...Just kidding？ Maybe that was a little ominous.
Well, when we've waited this long with no sign of rescue, it's hard not to think about the worst-case scenarios.
It might be inappropriate to say at a time like this, but... I'm actually really happy right now.
Yeah. It feels like something smoldering in my heart has finally cleared up.
If we can't leave this island, I don't have to worry about you going somewhere else.
I know. It's just my own silly delusion.
I'd suddenly get anxious for no reason, thinking you might disappear from my life some- day... It kept me up at night...
I love you so, so much... that I get scared thinking about what I'd do if you were gone.
It's not that... I guess I just don't have much confidence in myself.
If you say that, then ● is the same... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is the best girlfriend ● could ask for.
So don't say you lack confidence. No matter where we are or who's around, ● only has eyes for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Yeah... Thank you... Jeez, stop it.
I really wouldn't mind staying like this forever, as long as I'm with you...
Hey, this might not mean much in a place like this with no church or city hall, but...
I wonder what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was trying to say at the end there... Even if it was a dream, I'm curious.
